learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and skills to organize and manage projects. Knowing the organizational structure and functions of a project office.
Ability to exercise their profession with a cooperative and participatory attitude, and with social responsibility.

Ability to draft, sign and develop projects in the field of mechanical engineering whose purpose is the construction, renovation, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants and manufacturing and automation processes.
Ability to direct the activities that are the object of Mechanical Engineering projects.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, that enables them to learn new methods and theories, and provides them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of mechanical engineering.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans and other similar tasks.
Ability to handle specifications, regulations and mandatory standards.
Ability to analyze and evaluate the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Ability to apply quality principles and methods.
Ability to organize and plan within the company, and other institutions and organizations.
Ability to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.
Knowledge, understanding and ability to apply the necessary legislation in the exercise of the Industrial Technical Engineer profession.

To have acquired advanced knowledge and demonstrated an understanding of the theoretical and practical aspects and the work methodology in their field of study with a depth that reaches the forefront of knowledge.

To be able, through arguments or procedures elaborated and supported by themselves, to apply their knowledge, their understanding and their problem-solving skills in complex or professional and specialized work environments that require the use of creative and innovative ideas.

To have the ability to collect and interpret data and information on which to base their conclusions, including, when necessary and relevant, reflection on social, scientific or ethical issues in their field of study.
To be able to cope with complex situations or those that require the development of new solutions both in the academic and work or professional environment within their field of study.
To know how to communicate to all types of audiences (specialized or not) clearly and precisely, knowledge, methodologies, ideas, problems and solutions in their field of study.

To be able to identify their own training needs in their field of study and work or professional environment and to organize their own learning with a high degree of autonomy in all types of contexts (structured or not).
Knowledge and understanding: To be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.
Practical application of engineering: Understanding of applicable techniques and methods of analysis, project and research and their limitations in their field of specialization.
Practical application of engineering: Practical competence to solve complex problems, carry out complex engineering projects and conduct research specific to their specialization.
Practical application of engineering: Knowledge of the application of materials, equipment and tools, technology and engineering processes and their limitations in their field of specialization.
Practical application of engineering: Ability to apply engineering practice standards in their field of specialization.
Practical application of engineering: General ideas on economic, organizational and management issues (such as project management, risk and change management) in the industrial and business context.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Communication and Teamwork: Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with engineers and people from other disciplines.
Continuous training: Ability to keep up to date with new developments in science and technology.
Defines the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, arguing and justifying each one of them, and making correct use of language, in writing.
Defines the problem, the development of the solution, as well as the conclusions effectively, arguing and justifying each one of them, and making correct use of language, orally.
Analyzes the intervening variables in the problematic solution and proposes actions for a stable situation.
Assumes responsibilities in the work team, organizing and planning the tasks to be developed, facing contingencies and promoting the participation of its members.
Selects, applies and evaluates, in unknown contexts, the most appropriate methods, techniques, regulations, etc., typical of the engineering profession.

syllabus_topics: Execution of tasks assigned by the company

assessment_methods.method: Technical ability, involvement in the project/PBL, work performed, results obtained, documentation submitted, technical presentation and defense
Observation of student participation and attitude in proposed training activities

assessment_rules: The course will have continuous assessment based on meetings with tutors. With the feedback offered in these meetings and partial submissions, students must improve the quality of their work, activity, report, and presentation until the final evaluation. If the course is not passed or the final report is not submitted, the course must be repeated. There are no resit mechanisms.
